function stringOnly() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { x = 'bye'; throw 0; } catch { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
function unchanged() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { throw 0; } catch { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
function nestedHandled() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } catch { x = 'ok'; } } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
  console.log(x);
}
function nestedFinalized() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } finally { x = 'ok'; } } catch { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
function nestedCatchThrows() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } catch { throw 0; } } catch { console.log(typeof x); x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function declarationsAreDeferred() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { const callback = () => { x = 1; }; function withDefault(value = (x = 2)) { return value; } throw 0; }
  catch { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
function inlineCompletion() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { (() => { x = 1; x = 'bye'; })(); } finally { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
function stringPatterns() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { ({value: x = 'default'} = {} as {value?: string}); throw 0; }
  catch { console.log(x.toUpperCase()); }
}
stringOnly();
unchanged();
nestedHandled();
nestedFinalized();
declarationsAreDeferred();
inlineCompletion();
stringPatterns();
function inlineCatch() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { (() => { x = 1; })(); throw 0; } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
function finallyThrows() {
  let x: string | number = 'hi';
  try { try { x = 1; throw 0; } finally { throw 0; } } catch { x.toUpperCase(); }
}
